mentions.name: kavla.dev
mentions.description: A SQL canvas tool providing a visual canvas for working with SQL, with support for pasting images. The builder is exploring layered graph drawing (Sugiyama) layout patterns for arranging nodes on the canvas.
mentions.source_excerpt: For kavla.dev (my SQL canvas) I'm exploring sugiyama (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Layered_graph_drawing)
